jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

Our passionate team from the areas of software development, engineering and data science works together on various projects from the whole Liebherr product world. Our mission: creating outstanding digital experiences!Your responsibilities- Understand the business - Assess and support the business objectives for digital products and services from a Cloud Applications point of view- Define the architecture - Create structures of distributed systems in close collaboration with other experts- Implement cloud services - Develop holistic software modules- Support deployment - Care about continuous integration and deployment processes- Collaborate in interdisciplinary teams - Being an enthusiastic agile team member- Ensure DevOps - You build it, you run it.Your qualifications- M.Sc. Computer Science and at least 7 years experience in .NET or Golang software development- Confident use of agentic AI tools for workflow automation, problem-solving, and software development- Proficiency in development of distributed software, cloud mechanisms, tooling and providers (Azure, AWS, Container, Kubernetes etc.)- Experience with Infrastructure as Code & continuous integration and DevOps- Proficiency with storage technologies (SQL DB, NoSQL DB, Data Lake, etc.)- Familiarity with Clean Code, Peer Review and Pair Programming- High degree of motivation & ability to collaborate in agile teams- Excellent spoken and written communication skills in German & EnglishOur offerA challenging and interesting range of activities awaits you at Liebherr in an internationally successful Group. We offer you a secure job with the social contributions of a modern organisation and pay a performance-based salary.Liebherr-Digital Development Center GmbHfranziska.rolle@liebherr.com

UNSERE MISSIONAt socialbee, we are on a mission to build a more inclusive society by creating fair job opportunities for migrants and refugees. We believe in authentic storytelling, lived diversity, and the power of digital media to drive real impact.We are looking for a creative Junior Social Media & Content Creator to bring our mission to life across all digital channels. In this role, you will plan, produce, and publish engaging content that resonates with our community. Working closely with our marketing and brand team in Munich, you will serve as an authentic on-camera face of socialbee while building meaningful connections with talents, partners, and supporters.DEINE ROLLE BEI UNS• Social media ownership: Manage content creation, posting schedule, and community engagement across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Reddit.• Content production & visual formats: Concept, film, and edit short-form videos (Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts), image posts, graphics, and newsletters tailored to channel audiences.• Event coverage & on-site stories: Capture real-time moments at team and community events in Munich through live coverage, short interviews, and behind-the-scenes content.• Impact storytelling: Translate authentic stories from program participants, corporate partners, and team members into inspiring digital content formats.• Team & workflow collaboration: Partner with marketing leads and cross-functional teams to translate strategic goals into creative, engaging campaigns.DAS BIST DU• Language skills & on-camera confidence: Strong command of English and German (both languages used daily in content creation and communication) with an authentic, engaging presence on camera. Additional languages are welcome!• Passion for our mission: Deep interest in socialbee's core topics, including diversity, equity & inclusion, integration, and social mobility.• Modern workflow & AI literacy: Curiosity and openness to integrating AI tools and modern content creation software to streamline editing and brainstorm fresh ideas.• Munich location & hybrid mindset: Based in or near Munich for easy collaboration at local events and key team meetups, combined with generous remote work flexibility.UNSER ANGEBOT AN DICH• Impact-driven culture: A supportive, value-led working environment where your creative ideas directly drive social change.• Flexible working model: High work-from-home flexibility coupled with a vibrant team hub in Munich.• Growth & development: Regular feedback and freedom to experiment with new digital formats and AI tools.• Team benefits: Competitive benefits package, regular team events, and an appreciative work environment.How to Apply• Please submit your CV along with a link to your content portfolio or short video introduction (e.g., sample TikTok, Instagram Reel, or short self-introduction video). We value skill, passion, and authenticity over perfect resumes. We look forward to getting to know you!Über unsWe're a non-profit social enterprise from Munich that connects people with a refugee or migration background to jobs that match their skills. With smart tools, learning offers and a lot of heart, we get talents job-ready and help companies build diverse teams. Our big goal: showing that migration drives Germany forward. Our vision: a world where everyone can make it. Sounds like you? Let's create chances together!

Good to know...Hybrid with a flexible office policy · Base in Germany or Switzerland, with regular travel to Berlin · Full-time · Reports to the Head of GrowthSwitzerland is an established market for Pets Deli with room to grow. We want to give it more focus, deepen our presence and accelerate growth, and this role is its owner.You take ownership of Pets Deli in Switzerland: the growth strategy, the performance marketing, new channels, and an online shop, delivery and assortment that fit Swiss customers. This is a strategic role with a hands-on reality, especially at the start: you run the Swiss performance campaigns yourself and add capacity to the team instead of only steering it. You think strategically and then do the work, with a central team behind you: paid social, creative, our Google Ads agency, tech, operations and R&D. You start as an individual contributor and build up local resources as the market needs them.We work hybrid with a flexible office policy. Your base can be in Germany or Switzerland, on the condition that you travel to Berlin regularly.Your tasks• Performance marketing. You own the Swiss performance channels: you steer our Google Ads agency, brief our Creative Strategist and video team on Swiss creatives, and manage the Swiss Meta campaigns hands-on inside our paid-social setup, from testing and scaling ads to the budget.• Growth and targets. New customers, revenue and CLV/CAC for Switzerland. You report on them monthly and decide where the budget goes.• New channels. You test and scale further channels for Switzerland, from influencers and marketplaces to local media, with clear test budgets and decision points.• Shop and delivery. With Tech and Operations: CHF pricing, payment methods, legal texts, customs handling and delivery promises that match the German experience.• Market strategy. A growth plan for Switzerland: what we take from Germany, what we adapt to Swiss customers, pricing, competition and media.• Pricing and assortment. Market input on pricing, and Swiss customer needs translated into product opportunities with R&D.Your ProfileWhat you bring• Deep knowledge of the Swiss market and its customers, gained by living or working there. You know what selling to Swiss consumers from abroad takes.• A background in digital marketing or e-commerce with a solid understanding of performance marketing. You have, for example, run Meta campaigns yourself or steered an agency.• A hands-on generalist who finds the opportunity, turns it into a plan and then executes. A spreadsheet, an ad account and a fulfilment call on the same day are normal for you.• Commercial thinking: you steer on CLV/CAC and contribution, not on clicks.• You get things done through central teams and partners that do not report to you.• German at native or near-native level, Swiss German at least at understanding level, fluent English. French is a plus.What makes you successful in this role• You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach: you enjoy developing plans as much as making them happen.• You are comfortable challenging established approaches and bringing new perspectives to the business.• You balance long-term market building with short-term commercial priorities.• You want significant ownership and work closely with the central team leads to use it.Are we a match?A lot works differently here than in a classic company:• We try things out, decide quickly and correct just as quickly.• You carry real responsibility. And where nobody is in charge, you step in.• Results count, not hours or titles. Decisions are made on facts, not on hierarchy.• We say openly what we think: directly, in every direction and with respect.• Obstacles do not knock us off course, and constantly learning something new is what drives us.If fixed structures, stable priorities or titles matter more to you than moving things forward, you will not be happy with us.Your Chances• Ownership of a market with a clear mandate and direct access to the leadership team.• A central growth, creative and agency setup you can use from day one, and a role that grows with the market.• A hybrid model with a flexible office policy and a base in Germany or Switzerland, plus a Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg with office dogs.• A competitive salary, a personal development budget, internal coaching and regular team events.• 40 % discount on all Pets Deli orders and a €50 monthly benefit allowance.About us Pets Deli is the leading premium pet food D2C brand in Germany. Whereas human nutrition has seen a strong development in the past years when it comes to basics such as transparency, sustainable consumption and overall health contribution, there is still a long way to go in the pet food sector. And we don’t just want to be along for the ride here but instead — are heavily shaping this transformation. Our mission is simple and ambitious: create a better world for pet lovers. To achieve this, we focus on three pillars: better and healthier food, informative and educational content and digital services.Office Tour

Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. As an MQR Technician at ESMC in Dresden, you play a central role in ensuring operational quality, accurate documentation, and process reliability. You bridge the gap between cleanroom operations, quality data analysis, and document management. In close collaboration with our engineering teams and international counterparts at TSMC HQ, you ensure that quality standards, offline calibration, and statistical process controls run smoothly from day one.Job Responsibilities• Quality Data & Reporting: Support engineers by preparing preliminary reports, tracking SPC (Statistical Process Control) charts, and gathering data for Cpk and process health indices.• Document Control Management: Create, review, update, and archive quality- and production-related documents in compliance with international semiconductor standards.• Offline Calibration & Tool Management: Coordinate recalls, maintain calibration records, audit calibration status labels, and interface with external third-party calibration vendors.• Wafer Logistics & Cross-Fab Collaboration: Coordinate wafer shipments between ESMC and Taiwan fabs for qualification, testing, and quality defense.• Metrology & Tool Matching Support: Assist engineers with metrology tool gating, tool matching activities, and quality verification tasks.• Audit & Discrepancy Checks: Conduct regular checks on quality documents and system entries to detect and resolve discrepancies early.• Knowledge Transfer: Train junior team members and provide first-level support to internal users regarding the document management system.Your profile Must Have• Completed 3-year vocational training (e.g., as a Chemical Laboratory Technician / Chemielaborant, CTA, PTA, Physics Technician, or a comparable technical/scientific background).• Up to 3 years of professional experience in an office, manufacturing, or laboratory environment.• Solid computer literacy, including intermediate skills in Microsoft Office (especially MS Excel for data evaluation).• Structured, detail-oriented working style with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a dynamic operations environment.• Willingness to complete a ~6-month hands-on training program in Taiwan during your onboarding to build core competencies and an international network.• Fluent English skills (written and spoken); basic German communication skills.Nice to Have• Initial experience in the semiconductor, pharmaceutical, medical device, or other highly regulated industries.• Familiarity with Document Control Systems, calibration management, or basic SPC concepts.• Advanced Excel skills (Formulas, Macros/VBA) or initial exposure to SQL.• Basic knowledge of Mandarin is an asset.Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: - The Institute of Active Polymers at Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins for its activities in the field of stem cell modification and biomaterials at its Teltow site. The position is initially limited until 30 November 2028.Equal opportunity is an integral part of our personnel policy. The full-time position (39 hours per week) can, in principle, also be filled on a part-time basis.Your tasks:Scientific and methodological tasks:- design and perform mechanobiology experiments with primary T cells, B cells and/or other immune cells at engineered biomaterial interfaces- develop, optimize and apply advanced fluorescence and super-resolution microscopy to resolve receptor organization, close-contact formation, cytoskeletal architecture and signalling in living and fixed cells- establish and use biomaterial model systems, including nanostructured surfaces, hydrogels/​​viscoelastic materials and functionalized interfaces with controlled mechanics, topography and ligand presentation- build quantitative image-analysis workflows for large 2D/3D/4D microscopy data sets and extract spatial, dynamic and biophysical features at the single-cell and subcellular level- integrate imaging, mechanical and functional measurements into digital-twin models of immune-cell activation and cell-material interactions- develop, fit and validate mechanistic and data-driven models (e.g. ODE, agent-based, biophysical, statistical or machine-learning approaches as appropriate), including parameter inference and sensitivity analysis- use an iterative model-experiment cycle to generate testable predictions and experimentally validate and refine the digital twins- quantify immune-cell activation, signalling, morphology and function using complementary cellbiological and biophysical assays, including flow cytometry and live-cell measurements- cooperate closely with microscopy, materials-science, computational and immunology partners and contribute to shared experimental and data standards- prepare scientific publications, conference contributions, invention disclosures where relevant, and contribute to follow-up funding and grant applications- supervise MSc students and interns and contribute to the scientific mentoring of PhD studentsRelated tasks:- literature and data analysis in the relevant fields; documentation and reproducible/​FAIR management of imaging, analysis and modelling workflows- procurement of materials and consumables; participation in group, institute and project meetings, partner meetings, trainings and scientific networking activities- preparation and maintenance of experimental protocols, analysis code, model documentation, progress reports and training materialsYour profile:Education:- Doctoral degree (PhD/Dr.) in biophysics, physics, bioengineering/​biomedical engineering, materials science/​biomaterials, cell biology, immunology or a comparable fieldExpertise and experience:- strong hands-on expertise in at least one of the following areas: advanced fluorescence/​superresolution microscopy, quantitative bioimaging, mechanobiology or biomaterials; demonstrated ability and motivation to expand into the adjacent areas- experience with mammalian cell culture; experience with primary immune cells and immune-cell assays is highly desirable- experience with SMLM, SIM, STED, light-sheet or comparable advanced microscopy methods is desirable- knowledge of cell-material interfaces, hydrogels, nanostructured surfaces and/or mechano­transduction is advantageous- strong quantitative image-analysis skills and scientific programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R; Fiji/​lmageJ or comparable tools)- experience with mathematical modelling, machine learning or digital-twin approaches is an advantage; a strong interest in integrating experiments with predictive models is expected- demonstrated capacity for independent scientific work, publication of research results, interdisciplinary teamwork and clear scientific communication in EnglishOur offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions- individual opportunities for training and development- an excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- a family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e.g. a parent-child room- workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- corporate BenefitsSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You start your day by reviewing project progress, key milestones, risks, dependencies and open actions across strategic initiatives. Together with workstream leads and cross-functional teams, you align priorities, facilitate project meetings and ensure that decisions are translated into clear responsibilities and timelines. Throughout the day, you coordinate stakeholders, resolve implementation issues, update project plans and prepare concise status reports or decision papers for leadership. Your focus is on maintaining transparency, execution discipline and driving projects from planning through to measurable results. How You’ll Make an Impact * Management and implementation of strategic and cross-functional projects, including business initiatives, partnerships, transformation programs and continuous improvement activities* Translation of strategic priorities and management decisions into structured project scopes, workplans, milestones, responsibilities and deliverables* Establishment and maintenance of project governance frameworks, including meeting structures, reporting routines, decision processes and escalation mechanisms* Coordination of cross-functional teams and workstreams, facilitation of project meetings and follow-up on actions, commitments and deliverables* Monitoring of schedules, resources, dependencies, risks and issues, including initiation of corrective actions to ensure successful project execution* Preparation of project status reports, steering documents and decision papers for leadership, as well as support for strategic analyses and implementation-related concept workWhat You Bring* Master’s degree or equivalent in business administration, engineering, economics or another relevant discipline* Several years of experience in project management, PMO or implementation of cross-functional initiatives, ideally complemented by exposure to strategy, transformation or business development* Proven experience managing complex projects, including project setup, governance, scheduling, milestone tracking, stakeholder coordination, risk and issue management* Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans and successfully drive implementation across functions and international teams* Excellent project management, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a structured, pragmatic and results-oriented working style* High level of ownership, reliability and persistence, confidence in working with senior stakeholders in a global organization, fluent business English and German as an advantageAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
